verdict.rationale: Make has a broad resource-oriented REST API covering connections, connection access lists, data stores, analytics, audit logs, AI agents (open beta), on-prem agents and custom properties. Its official MCP server can run scenarios and view or modify scenarios and related entities such as connections, webhooks and data stores. However, nothing in the pack states UI-to-API parity: the TypeScript SDK covers only a 'majority' of endpoints, analytics is Enterprise-only, AI agent endpoints are beta, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity claim, cited scenario CRUD and run endpoints in the API reference, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on or independent corroboration of full coverage.
